title: Angry Chick in Cosmic Tree
description: A large gnarled tree with a twisted trunk and branches frames a circular broken window or portal. Inside the portal, an angry yellow chick with boxing gloves stands on a branch against a sunny rural landscape, while a translucent purple ghost floats nearby. Black cat-like creatures and a small robot perch on the upper branches under a starry purple and green nebula sky.
